skill_outcomes.skill_name: Identify the impact of electronic media on business activities
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students can determine the effects of modern electronic media on business activities and analyze opportunities and risks in e-commerce operations management.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Differentiate the nature, characteristics, roles, and functions of e-commerce operations management
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students can distinguish between traditional and digital business operations management.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Analyze the influence of macro-environment, industry environment, and internal environment on e-commerce operations
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students can assess how these environments affect e-commerce operations and predict market needs.
Students can identify different types of online shopping, understand the purchasing process, recognize risks, and analyze factors affecting online purchases.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Determine human resource requirements for e-commerce businesses
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students can evaluate, classify, train, and recruit human resources for e-commerce businesses.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Manage products, quality, supply chains, inventory, and customer relationships in e-commerce
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students can manage various aspects of e-commerce operations including product management, quality control, supply chain management, inventory management, and customer relationship management.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Problem-solving and operational management in e-commerce
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students can solve problems and manage e-commerce operations related to product management, quality control, supply chain management, inventory management, and customer relationship management.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Information gathering, classification, comparison, debate, report writing
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students can collect information, classify it, compare data, debate issues, and write reports related to e-commerce operations management.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Data and information analysis in practical problem-solving
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students can analyze data and information to solve practical problems related to e-commerce operations management.
Students can independently learn and research, have professional integrity, be creative, accumulate knowledge and experience, and self-direct in task execution.
